newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-PEREC VOTED FRENCH SPORTS PERSONALITY OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PEREC VOTED FRENCH SPORTS PERSONALITY OF YEAR.

text.p: Double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec was voted French sports personality of the year for the second time at the weekend.

Perec, a member of France's highly successful team at the Atlanta Games in August, won the poll organised by the sports daily L'Equipe on Sunday ahead of Olympic judo champion David Douillet, last year's winner.
She also won the award in 1992 after her victory in the 400 metres at the Barcelona Olympics. She won both the 200 and 400 at Atlanta.

Another athlete, surprise Olympic pole vault champion Jean Galfione, was fifth, behind cyclist Florian Rousseau, gold medal winner in the one kilometre at Atlanta, and France's Davis Cup-winning tennis team.
In a separate poll on Friday, Barcelona libero Laurent Blanc was voted France's footballer of the year. Blanc won the French league and cup double with Auxerre in May before joining the Spanish club.
